content: Google will soon allow you to customize your Discover feed by describing what you want to see. The new feature, rolling out to the Google app in the “coming days,” will use AI to automatically tweak your feed and “remember” your preferences for future visits. You’ll find the option within the three-dot menu on your Discover feed. As shown in a video shared by Google, tapping the feature will open a chatbot-style interface, where you’ll be able to describe your preferences. The chatbot will confirm your choices and lay out the types of content it will prioritize, but you’ll also have the option to add more information if it doesn’t get it quite right. From there, you can hit “Refresh your feed” for the changes to take effect. [Video: Google Discover AI customization] This might make it easier to control what you see in your Discover feed, which serves up recommended articles based on your activity across Google’s search engine and apps. Aside from Google Discover, several social media apps have added ways to customize your feeds with AI, including YouTube, Instagram, Bluesky, and X. Google announced a couple of other changes as well, including the ability to personalize daily audio briefings in the Google News app on Android. [Image: You can now choose the topics you want to hear about in your Google News audio briefing. https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/08/google-audio-briefing-custom.webp?quality=90&strip=all] There’s also an update to Preferred Sources, a feature that lets you see more of your favorite outlets across Search’s “top stories” section, AI Overviews, and AI Mode. With the change, publishers can place an interactive “Preferred Sources” button on their sites, which readers can select to quickly add it to their list without navigating away from the webpage.
chineseTitle: Google Discover 正在获得 AI 聊天机器人调整的提要
chineseSummary: Google 很快将允许您通过描述您想要看到的内容来自定义您的 Discover feed。这项新功能将在“未来几天”推出到谷歌应用程序，将使用人工智能自动调整您的信息流并“记住”您未来访问的偏好。您将在 [...] 上的三点菜单中找到该选项
chineseContent: Google 很快将允许您通过描述您想要看到的内容来自定义您的 Discover feed。这项新功能将在“未来几天”推出到谷歌应用程序，将使用人工智能自动调整您的信息流并“记住”您未来访问的偏好。您可以在“发现”提要的三点菜单中找到该选项。正如谷歌分享的视频所示，点击该功能将打开一个聊天机器人风格的界面，您可以在其中描述您的偏好。聊天机器人将确认您的选择并列出它将优先考虑的内容类型，但如果它不太正确，您也可以选择添加更多信息。从那里，您可以点击“刷新您的源”以使更改生效。 [视频：Google Discover AI 定制] 这可能会让您更轻松地控制您在 Discover feed 中看到的内容，Discover feed 会根据您在 Google 搜索引擎和应用程序中的活动提供推荐文章。除了 Google Discover 之外，一些社交媒体应用程序还添加了通过 AI 自定义提要的方法，包括 YouTube、Instagram、Bluesky 和 ​​X。Google 还宣布了其他一些更改，包括在 Android 上的 Google News 应用程序中个性化每日音频简报的功能。 [图片：您现在可以选择您想在 Google 新闻音频简报中听到的主题。 https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/08/google-audio-briefing-custom.webp?quality=90&strip=all] 首选来源也进行了更新，该功能可让您在搜索的“头条新闻”部分、AI 概述和 AI 模式中查看更多您最喜爱的媒体。通过这一更改，出版商可以在其网站上放置一个交互式“首选来源”按钮，读者可以选择该按钮将其快速添加到他们的列表中，而无需导航
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于 AI 与科技趋势信号，适合用于观察工具选型、产品机会、开发者关注点和技术路线变化。
